# Tag

A compact label for metadata or status, with variant and emotion colours and an optional remove action. Use Chip when the value is an interactive selection rather than a label.

- **Import:** `import { Tag } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/data-display-tag--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { Tag, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function TagExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <Tag>Tag</Tag>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Tag

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `TagProps`, which extends `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, VariantProps<typeof tagVariants>`.

- `onRemove`: `() => void`, optional.
- `emotion`: `Emotion`, optional.

  What the tag means. Leave it unset and the variant renders exactly as it
  always has. Set it and the emotion decides the colour: `outline` becomes
  the emotion as text with a matching edge, and every other variant becomes
  the emotion's filled pair.

  The product drives this axis on 33,988 tag instances across 10 surfaces
  and Kozmos could express none of it before now.

- `variant`: `"default" | "destructive" | "outline" | "secondary" | null`, optional, default `"default"`.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### Emotion

From `@kozmos-ds/react`, which does not export it by name.

```ts
type Emotion = (typeof EMOTIONS)[number];
```
